model_output.verdict: A senior payments engineer whose resume connects technical decisions to measurable changes.
write_up: This is a strong senior backend resume! Your payments work at Tidewater Commerce shows both technical leadership and changes to reconciliation, reliability, and audit readiness. The earlier billing work reinforces that story.

The invoice generation line at Northwind Billing is a great model: it gives the before and after and names the database change that got it there. Your experience leads, and the progression from billing to payments is easy to follow.

Your resume isn't likely to be what holds you back. Competition for a particular role will still matter. For a more senior position, add the broader technical decisions you owned if that work is part of your story.

cards.line: - Reduced invoice generation time from 6 hours to 25 minutes by batching database writes
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It pairs a concrete engineering choice with a change a recruiter can immediately grasp.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 1
cards.line: - Designed and led the migration of card authorization from a monolith to a Go service handling 4,500 requests per second at p99 under 80 ms
